region: Lake Ray Hubbard and North Texas lake shores: 1970s brick ranches to 2020s modern farmhouses
_about: Building materials region pack (Track E2). Everything specific to a place lives here: which finishes it has, their real unit sizes, palettes, mortar and paint colours, and the test houses. The code is the same for every region: each finish names a class (buildmat_hlsl.CLASSES: how it is drawn and how it wears), and the finish ids are what the parts kit writes in vertex colour G (Tools/envloop/buildkit/slots.json: wall ids 0.., roof ids 0..). Another region adds a pack with its own finishes on the same material slots. Sizes are the interim size card until Track 0's lands; colours are sRGB hex as seen on a dry wall in shade, before wear. tile_m is the real size one texture covers: whole bricks, boards or shingle rows, so the courses run on across tiles. Texture sharpness: px per tile on Ultra (1024: about 4 mm a pixel), half on High, a quarter on Medium.
